name: Mag
desc:
Mag is a Birch Gremor NPC. They can craft Bullet Casings by converting 200 Bullets into specialized variants using Ores, for a fee of up to 40. These modified bullets offer unique properties and playstyles.

They wear a Black Plain Hood and the Summer Company Uniform.
additional_info:
-   Their name is a reference to magazines, a part found on guns.
-   The [Gunsmith](entity:gunsmith) NPC found in the Guild Base is near identical to Mag, with the only exception being their appearance.
